title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 + MTP settings reference for a custom vLLM image
status: Reusable settings reference. Documentation only; not an installation recipe or an automatically applied default.

evidence_basis.scope: Dated container and launcher metadata. Package versions come from the record; installed packages and physical hardware were not independently queried by this inspection.

checkpoint.verification_history: Historical model verification is recorded; the later capture compared file sizes without recomputing hashes. Verify weights in your own installation.

runtime_dependency_inventory.image: Custom local image. Inherited VLLM_IMAGE_TAG declares vllm/vllm-openai:v0.29.0; this label does not establish build ancestry. Dated private metadata records vLLM 0.29.0, torch 2.13.0+cu130 and transformers 5.16.1; this inspection did not query installed packages. CUDA_VERSION declares 13.0.2 and NVARCH declares sbsa. Exact build recipe and source modifications were not established by this inspection; stock compatibility is unproven.
